page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top ("INVOCAT. SANCT.") with page number 273 at top right. Below it a heading "SEQUENTIA:" then two parallel columns of verse (left column and right column, each with a stanza pair). Then a heading "DE QVOLIBET SANCTO." followed by two parallel columns of verse. Then heading "DE RELIQVIIS SANCTORVM." and running prose paragraphs in one full-width column. Catchword/signature at foot: "S" and "Iterum" marked at the bottom right.

main_text.head: SEQUENTIA:
DE QVOLIBET SANCTO.
DE RELIQVIIS SANCTORVM.
main_text.p: Domine, ne respicias peccata nostra, sed respice ad deprecationem Genitricis tuæ Mariæ, & per ejus sancta merita, & per intercessionem sanctorum tuorum Apostolorum Petri & Pauli, atque omnium Sanctorum tuorum, quorum reliquiæ sunt in isto loco, adjuva nos, sicut tu vides necessitatem nostram.

Et: Deus, qui ex omni coaptatione Sancto-rum æternum tibi condis habitaculum, da æ-dificationi tuæ incrementa cœlestia, ut, quo-rum hic reliquias pio amore complectimur, eorum semper meritis adjuvemur.

page.notes: Two-column verse on the page; the catchword-like marks at foot are "S" and "Iterum". Some words in the columns are damaged by ink show-through and wear; the verse line-ends are uncertain, marked by my reading of the scan without [?] where clear enough. Several verse lines in the left column near the centre are partly illegible.
